pr_title: fix(es/minifier): Fix code for dropping unreachable statements
pr_body:
**Description:**

We should preserve return in this case.

**Related issue:**

 - Closes https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/6405.

issue_context.title: Whole `if` block is omitted in case throw after the `return undefined`
comments: This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.

review_comments: Ok, so that's one bug that's fixed. But I'm still confused how, even if we were to drop the return statement, we end up also dropping the `if (!!val)` wrapper around the throw?
